title: 中国AI模型追赶美国，价格优势成关键
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Chinese AI models are catching up to U.S. ones faster than ever before, and is doing it with limited access to capital and the best chips.
segments.zh: 中国的人工智能模型正以前所未有的速度追赶美国，尽管在资本和顶尖芯片方面受限。

segments.en: Alongside Val's AI, we asked seven models to be a fictional coffee shop website called Bloomberg. Almost all models were able to create fully functional websites,
segments.zh: 我们让七个模型为一个虚构的咖啡店网站生成页面，几乎所有模型都能创建功能完整的网站。

segments.en: and Forepix Fable 5 took less than an hour to create a polished website with about $50 worth of tokens. It's already a bargain for a website,
segments.zh: 其中，Forepix Fable 5 用了不到一小时，花费约50美元就打造出一个精美的网站，这已经很划算了。

segments.en: but the Kimi K3 model from China's moonshot sputes something similar for about a quarter of the price. Open AI's budget GPT model and Alibaba's
segments.zh: 但中国月之暗面的Kimi K3模型以约四分之一的价格完成了类似任务。OpenAI的预算模型和阿里的千问甚至更便宜。

segments.en: Queen were even cheaper, although Queen 3.7 max outputs was more bare-bones.
segments.zh: 不过，千问3.7 max的输出较为简陋。

segments.en: Cheaper and capable enough Chinese options are becoming irresistible for many companies.
segments.zh: 对于许多公司来说，中国提供的更便宜且功能足够的选择正变得难以抗拒。

segments.en: Major U.S. tech firms like DoorDash and Airbnb have already adopted Chinese AI.
segments.zh: DoorDash和Airbnb等美国科技巨头已采用中国的人工智能。

segments.en: Users also don't have to send data to China to use Chinese models.
segments.zh: 用户使用中国模型也无需将数据发送到中国。

segments.en: Most of China's top AI models are open-weight, meaning anyone can download, modify, and deploy these models however they want.
segments.zh: 中国顶尖的人工智能模型大多是开放权重的，任何人都可以下载、修改和部署。

segments.en: Still, Washington's hardware expert controls may keep Chinese AI models behind the U.S.
segments.zh: 不过，华盛顿的硬件出口管制可能仍会让中国的人工智能模型落后于美国。
